scenes.name: city
scenes.prompt: An ancient lost city suspended inside an enormous seed shell, an impossible majestic civilization with no people. A curved avenue of densely engraved black basalt leads from the foreground into the distance through intricate golden aqueducts, needle towers, ribbed temples, staircases on multiple gravity planes and bridges spiraling overhead. Thousands of tiny sculpted chambers and filigree terraces are carved into every monumental building. Streams of molten gold flow upward between the towers. The architectural forms have the precision of an exceptionally detailed copperplate engraving and ornate black lacquer sculpture, with metallic gold illuminated in narrow shafts of amber light. Black, warm bone white and molten brass, restrained deep oxblood accents, no green vegetation. A large circular iris of interlocking stone blades floats at the end of the avenue, framing a small icy blue crystalline world beyond. Dramatic asymmetrical wide view, deep layered perspective, a legible passage between immense ornate structures, no central giant face, no text, no ordinary buildings, no people. Unreal and extravagant dimensional etching, landscape 3:2.

scenes.name: travel-between-gravity-planes
scenes.prompt: Travelling low above a curved engraved black basalt avenue in an immense lost city. Black needle towers rise on both sides, covered in impossibly fine gold filigree, terraced chambers and microscopic carved arches. Ribbed bridges cross above, rivers of molten gold flow upward. Ahead a monumental stone iris opens onto a pale floating crystal. Keep the avenue an open clear route. Surreal intricately engraved architectural sculpture, black lacquer, brass, warm bone light and pale cold distance, exquisite fine detail and majestic depth. No green jungle, no plants, no people, no text.

scenes.name: the-city-folds-upward
scenes.prompt: The avenue of a lost black and gold city rises in a graceful curve toward an enormous stone iris. One bridge peels upward to join a distant tower, defying gravity. Gold inlaid lines flow along the engraved road. Finely carved black basalt towers and copper filigree surround a clear central passage. The distant icy crystal is visible through the iris. Monumental impossible architecture, black lacquer and intricate brass engraving, rich shadows and narrow shafts of bone white light. No plants, no jungle, no people, no text.
